data.gender_notes: Nudoora is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nud', meaning 'to light up' or 'to illuminate'. In Islamic tradition, Nudoora represents a beacon of light and guidance. The name Nudoora carries the meaning “A Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nudoora usually hope their child will grow to embody a light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nudoora belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nudoora total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
